scope: Union of both tracked engine trees excluding Addons/, docs/ and upstream/
normalisation: CRLF to LF for text; binary bytes unchanged

build.removal_path: Replace external native CMake policy with equivalent upstream targets; preserve source selection and matching-data preflight.
build.removal_trigger: Equivalent upstream implementation and unchanged native/original-mission regressions pass

host-platform.removal_path: Adopt upstream native host, VFS, input and audio services, then remove the matching platform implementation and dependent registrations.
host-platform.removal_trigger: Equivalent upstream implementation and unchanged native/original-mission regressions pass

graphics.removal_path: Adopt an upstream native graphics client and cockpit services, then remove WgpuClient and its build targets/assets.
graphics.removal_trigger: Equivalent upstream implementation and unchanged native/original-mission regressions pass

sdk-core.removal_path: Adopt equivalent upstream portable SDK/core changes after original mission and state regressions pass.
sdk-core.removal_trigger: Equivalent upstream implementation and unchanged native/original-mission regressions pass

regression-tools.removal_path: Retain or upstream the corresponding validation; remove only with equivalent upstream coverage.
regression-tools.removal_trigger: Equivalent upstream implementation and unchanged native/original-mission regressions pass

native-assets.removal_path: Replace with equivalent upstream licensed native assets and remove their generation/build references.
native-assets.removal_trigger: Equivalent upstream implementation and unchanged native/original-mission regressions pass

upstream-omissions.removal_path: Restore omitted upstream files if required by native packaging; remove their omission records once restored.
